candidates.title: Injecting Adrenaline into LLM Serving: Boosting Resource Utilization and Throughput via Attention Disaggregation
candidates.reason: Attention-disaggregation serving system that offloads decode attention work to underutilized prefill resources to improve cluster utilization and throughput.

candidates.title: Triton-distributed: Programming Overlapping Kernels on Distributed AI Systems with the Triton Compiler
candidates.reason: Distributed Triton compiler extension supporting communication primitives and computation-memory-communication overlap across up to 64 devices.

candidates.title: The Cost of Dynamic Reasoning: Demystifying AI Agents and Test-Time Scaling from an AI Infrastructure Perspective
candidates.reason: System-level characterization of agentic/test-time-scaling workloads covering latency, resource use, energy, and datacenter power implications.

candidates.title: SAGA: Workflow-Atomic Scheduling for AI Agent Inference on GPU Clusters
candidates.reason: Workflow-level GPU scheduler for agentic inference that preserves/reuses intermediate KV state and coordinates affinity, batching, stealing, and fairness.

candidates.title: IANUS: Integrated Accelerator based on NPU-PIM Unified Memory System
candidates.reason: NPU-PIM unified-memory accelerator with PIM access scheduling and workload mapping; evaluated on transformer/GPT workloads with hardware prototype evidence.
